name: Campaign Hub
description: Turns a Digital Garden into a hub for a West Marches tabletop campaign: a home dashboard built from job, session, character and facility notes, plus job board, expedition log, roster and rebuild pages.
author: Jake Hill

settings.name: Jobs on the rumour board
settings.description: How many open or taken jobs the home page pins to the rumour board. The rest are on the job board page.

settings.name: Expeditions on the home page
settings.description: How many of the most recent expedition reports the home page lists.

settings.name: Overheard rumours
settings.description: Show every rumour from the home note, or three of them picked at random in the reader's browser on each visit.

settings.name: Hex map data
settings.description: Where the hexcrawl-map plugin publishes its data. The map card is hidden if this cannot be fetched.

settings.name: Property strip on notes
settings.description: Show a small strip of key properties under the title of job, session and character notes.

settings.name: Campaign theme
settings.description: Restyle the whole site with a parchment and ink palette and the Cinzel and EB Garamond typefaces from Google Fonts. Leave this off to keep your current garden theme.
